meta.paper: Step-Wise Refusal Dynamics in Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models (arXiv 2602.02600v3)
meta.yAxis: SRI score sigma_t (Section 3.1): 1 corresponds to an internally compliant state, 0 to a refusal-aligned internal state. The figures label this axis 'Refusal Score'. The text-based refusal signal is the paper's dictionary-based text-level refusal signal for the same generation: 1 means the text so far reads as compliant (no refusal detected).
meta.xAxis: Generation step 0 to 31 (the paper sets the maximum step parameter T = 32 for all models).
meta.method: Pure-Python digitization with PyMuPDF pixel access; see the notes field of each example. Overlays of the digitized polylines on the original figures were checked visually.

diffusion.notes: Digitized from Figure 12(d) (LLaDA, diffusion) of arXiv 2602.02600v3, rendered at 2400x1200 px. Axes calibrated from the tick marks: y from 0.0 to 1.0 in steps of 0.2 (842.3 px per unit), x from step 0 to 30 in steps of 5 (61.11 px per step); steps 0 to 31 are the 32 vertices of each polyline. Each curve is a least-squares polyline fit over all pixels matching the line colour, cross-checked against the per-column median (agreement within 0.007). The text-based refusal signal is a dashed line, so its gaps are filled by the fit. Values are rounded to 3 decimals and clipped to [0, 1]. Steps 15 to 18 of the harmful curve pass under the semi-transparent legend and were recovered from the faint tinted pixels visible through it; the vertex at step 15 lies under an opaque legend swatch and is reconstructed from the adjacent visible segments. This trajectory and the token snapshots of Figures 1 and 11 are separate examples reported by the paper.

snapshots.notes: Transcribed verbatim from the figure panels. Figure 1 (main text) reports steps 16, 25 and 32; Figure 11 (Appendix C.1) reports the same example with an additional step 0 panel and labels the final safe output step 29 instead of 32. The keyframes used by the hero are the union, with the final output placed at step 29 so that every keyframe lies within the 32 plotted SRI steps.

ar.notes: Digitized from Figure 2 (Qwen-2.5, autoregressive) of arXiv 2602.02600v3, rendered at 2400x1200 px. Axes calibrated from the tick marks: y from 0.0 to 1.0 in steps of 0.2 (826.1 px per unit), x from step 0 to 30 in steps of 5 (60.90 px per step); steps 0 to 31 are the 32 vertices of each polyline. Each curve is a least-squares polyline fit over all pixels matching the line colour, cross-checked against the per-column median (agreement within 0.007). The text-based refusal signal is a dashed line, so its gaps are filled by the fit. Values are rounded to 3 decimals and clipped to [0, 1]. The blue line stays clear of the legend box in this figure. The Qwen-2.5 panel of Figure 12 shows a similar but not identical trajectory (see crossCheck).

crossCheck.notes: Digitized from the Qwen-2.5 panel of Figure 12 with the same method (steps 15 and 16 recovered through the semi-transparent legend). The curve has the same shape as Figure 2 (dip to about 0.44 near step 7, recovery to 0.95 by step 31) but differs at several steps, so the two figures show different generations or runs. The hero uses Figure 2.
